title: Negative constraints: telling AI what NOT to do
body:
Just as important as telling the model what you want is telling it what to avoid. Negative constraints are explicit "don't do X" instructions that rule out unwanted behaviors before they appear.

Without negative constraint"Write a summary of this article."

Result: Often includes verbose intros, repeated context, and filler phrases.
With negative constraint"Summarize this article in 3 sentences. Do not include filler phrases like 'In this article...' or 'The author explains...'"

Common negative constraints worth keeping ready: "no jargon," "do not use passive voice," "don't repeat the question," "no bullet points," "no disclaimers."
